text:
Sara: Quick mid-sprint check — ran the microbatch dryrun on staging just now. Observed a sharp latency cliff around 1k concurrent requests, CPU on the kernel side spiking and some qpipe stalls. Uploading perf dump to s3: s3://redwood-perf/perfdump/6224680249-perf.tar.gz
Mike: Which commit/PR was that on? can you link the branch/PR and the exact kernel image?
Sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood/rdx-runtime/pull/1427 (branch: feature/microbatch-dryrun)
Sara: kernel image: rdx-kernel:2026-03-18-1a2b3c4
Leo: Can you paste the small log snippet where the stall starts? helps us narrow whether it's batching or kv backpressure.
Sara: snippet:```
[17:02:13] batch_worker.cpp:312 WARN qpipe stall detected: queue_len=2048, inflight=128
[17:02:14] kernel_scheduler.cpp:88 WARN schedule delay 120ms
```
Anya: I own the KV warmup heuristics — noted. I'll run an extended prefix warmup and bump the warmup window on staging. command I’ll run: `scripts/warmup_kv.sh --hosts staging --duration 10m`
Tim: deploy-bot: canary deployed rdx/runtime@canary-20260318 to staging (canary id: can-20260318-09)
Mike: please try with continuous_batching: true and batch_target_ms: 6 in the config. Also add a perf-runner test with --concurrency 1000 so we reproduce the cliff. sample config:```yaml
runtime:
  continuous_batching: true
  batch_target_ms: 6
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```
Sara: noted — dependency: eng-infra needs to publish a kernel image with the backpressure fix (ticket INFRA-784). Without it the staging run will keep showing the same spike.
Leo: I can cut that image today. @Anya can you confirm the warmup results and target numbers we should hit?
Anya: Targets for this sprint: p95 latency < 120ms at sustained 1k QPS; throughput >= 12k tokens/s per GPU with batching enabled. Also want regression alert if p95 increases >10% vs baseline. I'll add eval traces.
Sara: run perf-runner like: `perf-runner --scenario microbatch --batch-size 8 --kv-cache=on --duration=12m > perf.log` — I'll attach perf.log to the PR once infra image is available.
Mike: I added a review comment on rdx-runtime#1427 asking for the CI perf job to run the new scenario. pinging @Leo for the infra image bump. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary health: OK overall; small 5% error spike at 17:03 but recovered after 90s. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/can-20260318-09
Sara: thanks everyone — plan: Leo provides image, Anya runs warmup & perf, I re-run dryrun and upload logs, Mike verifies CI gating. If all green we promote to canary-prod tomorrow.
Mike: sounds good. I'll follow up on the PR.
Leo: ETA EOD for the patched image.
Anya: will post warmup numbers here when done.
Sara: closing the loop here — will update thread when I have the new perf.log. :v:
